newsitem.title: NORWAY: FORECAST-Norway's June CPI seen up 2.7 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Norway's June CPI seen up 2.7 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Norway's consumer prices (CPI) are expected to rise in June by an average 2.7 percent compared with June 1996, and to increase by 0.1 percent from May, according to a Reuter poll of 10 Norwegian and international analysts.
Year-on-year estimates for inflation ranged between 2.5 percent and 2.8 percent, while estimates for the month-on-month figure were between minus 0.1 percent and plus 0.2 percent.
For the year, analysts forecast inflation at 2.55 percent compared with projections of 2.49 percent in a May survey.
Norway's CPI is due to be released on July 10 at 0745 GMT.

Participants in the survey were Christiania og Kreditkasse, Den Danske Bank, Den norske Bank, Fondspartner, Fokus Bank, Handelsbanken, I.D.E.A., Orkla Finans, Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken, and Unibank.
